# Arcanthys Wiki Instructions

Refer to [Wiki Writing Style Guide](0_System%20&%20Meta/Wiki%20Writing%20Style%20Guide.md) for all content principles, tone, structure, and writing standards.

## Obsidian Title and Infobox Rule

Apply the "Obsidian Title and Infobox Rule" from the style guide as written, including title handling, infobox usage criteria, and lead-paragraph expectations:
- [Wiki Writing Style Guide](0_System%20&%20Meta/Wiki%20Writing%20Style%20Guide.md)

## Key Distinction

**Factual/Reference Pages** (gods, factions, confirmed doctrines, mechanics):
- State information **directly and clearly**
- Avoid false uncertainty
- Organize logically for reference

**Mythological/Historical Pages** (ancient events, disputed accounts, contested lore):
- Keep statements factual where canon is settled
- Use uncertainty phrasing only when modern-era in-world knowledge is unresolved
- Prefer in-world phrasing ("Some believe...", "It is said...", "According to legend...")
- Avoid source-authority phrasing ("According to certain sources...", "Scholars cannot reach a consensus...")
- Present contradictory sources where appropriate
- Maintain scholarly distance

Always determine which type you're working with before editing or creating.

## Canon Change Safeguard

Unless specifically asked to generate something new, do not create new lore or ideas.
If a proposed edit would introduce new lore or ideas, first confirm with the user that they want that change.
